name: Chamber of Filaments
promptTemplate: A vaulted dark chamber hung with {{filament_style}} incandescent bulbs tuned to {{color_temp}}, glowing with {{glow_reach}}x aura reach, sway at {{sway_intensity}}, and dust motes {{dust_motes}}.

glow_reach.hint: Expand the luminous halo around each bulb

sway_intensity.hint: Drafts set the suspended cords in motion

surge.hint: Overdrive your bulb and ripple through the room

cascade.hint: Trigger an expanding shockwave across all filaments

listing.blurb: A vaulted hall of hanging incandescent bulbs pulses to personal heartbeats, sending shockwaves of warm light rippling through the dark.
listing.prompt: A room of hanging incandescent bulbs, one per person in the room, each pulsing at its own heartbeat; anyone can press to send a strong pulse through their bulb, and the pulse ripples out through the nearest bulbs. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
